quests.title: The Fire Is New
quests.text: Old death I know: it smells of dust and patience, and this Tithe-Brand smells of a furnace; Mortuary Clerk Hush entered our dead as debtors, but Hush never had fire. Take its coin as pay and it owns you, living or dead; the living cannot even throw it away, only pass it on as pay for another death. Wash the fresh ash from the old stone at the {name:ashen_grave}, {dir_from_giver:ashen_grave}, and you will see the brand laid over the names. Report to the Warmaster; being Undead has never made us somebody's property.
quests.completion: The ash was fresh over old names: somebody is buying another term of service from people who already gave their lives. The Accord's seal points at a pay office, but I want the living hand behind it. Yarra Standardmender has found a standard pledged against these wages, and I will send you to learn what was promised under it.

objectives.label: Wash fresh ash from old stone

quests.title: A Name on the Strap
quests.text: Watch gear lies abandoned at {name:r20_anchor_083}, and some of its straps still carry their owners' marks. Record those names before the gear is gathered into one anonymous heap. A buckle is a small thing to remember someone by, but it should at least reach the person doing the remembering.

objectives.label: Record the names on the gear

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OR1: a use at the free clash site 083 (beside F6's snares, another object); Blackwind's first armor choice.

quests.title: Before It Becomes Salvage
quests.text: The belongings at {name:r20_anchor_076} are being eyed by people who find 'unclaimed' a very convenient word. Post the notice reserving the dead's personal effects for their kin, so the salvage crews leave them alone. I would rather settle this with a notice than spend a week asking a scrap dealer whose initials he has melted.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OR2, the check's fix (it repeated blackwind_recovery_rest's secured bundle): a posted claim against salvage instead (claim_notice, an existing kind); a use at the free clash site 076; Blackwind's weapon (a solo quest, reward level 50: the band 41-50).

quests.title: What Reaches Ashveil
quests.text: Reports from the Gravesalt crews reach Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch, here in Blackwind Rise. She has people waiting for word, and work enough keeping the returning parties supplied. Go and offer her help; a visitor who can answer a question makes a pleasant change from a badly folded report.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only): a departure to a giver with work at once.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft OR3: the free travel to Vaska at 52.

quests.title: Keep What Can Be Kept
quests.text: The recovery parties bring back damp packs as often as sound supplies, and I need salt for the stores and for preserving what can be kept of their contents. Bring me six Rock Salt. I cannot promise every belonging will reach its people unchanged, but I can give it a better chance.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft VA1; Blackwind's first 51-60 armor choice.

quests.title: A Place for Their Belongings
quests.text: Returning a person's things takes someone willing to receive them, especially when the person cannot come home. Ossa Quietregister arranges that work in Nhal Veyr, and she needs help with the belongings recovered from the front. Go and speak to her; she will make certain a familiar name is not lost in a delivery tally.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only): a departure to a giver with work at once.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft VA2: the free departure to Ossa at 53.

quests.title: Word for the Next Party
quests.text: The next recovery party should know which loads have come back and which are still lying out there. Leave that account on the dispatch record at the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/work_laydown}, using the returns already gathered there. We ask enough of people without sending them to search for something another crew is carrying home.

objectives.label: Leave word for the next party

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft VA3, the check's fix (a signal lantern repeated blackwind_signal_lantern): a dispatch record at the new recipe place P5 (beside Borin's braces, another object); Blackwind's second 51-60 armor choice.

quests.title: Until the Names Are Read
quests.text: People keep vigil at Ashveil Watch while they wait for word of their dead, and the darkness makes every pause in the reading feel longer. Bring me twenty Torches to keep the vigil lit. They deserve to see the face of whoever brings them an answer.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft VA4, the check's fix (Mushrooms repeated Vaska's 'Something for Those Who Wait'): torches for the vigil instead of food.

quests.title: Dismissed, Captain
quests.text: Watch-Captain Huskell calls soldiers of both armies from the Undertithe's roll; each fresh payment buys their names for another watch. Kill four Last-Watch Sentries at night in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood} and defeat Huskell, {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}. I have listened long enough to hear the same names twice; let me hear where his list ends.
quests.completion: Both armies' dead are entered here, and the newest name is Tallykeeper Mardra; the money she sent out has bought her too. That tells us she is bound, not where she is, and her guilt gives the Undertithe no right to own her. Go to Nalo Pathdrum in Kezamba: he is watching Chirr, the payer who makes living roots carry these claims.

quests.title: Party: Nobody's Number
quests.text: Bog Witch Salt-Counter holds court {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, counting soldiers like grains of salt and never once by name. Gather a party and kill her; alone, you would only be one more grain on her scale. I remember names, and I would prefer not to add yours to the list I mourn.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft VA5 (K11 A): the optional group quest on Salt-Counter, standalone from its level; its id and objective stay, its prerequisite goes; a trinket choice.

quests.title: No Names Left to Own
quests.text: Huskell's roll ends with Mardra in fresh ink, and Chirr's payroll claims the same dead for the Undertithe. Burn our dead off the tally-stone at {name:r20_anchor_077}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_077}; leave it no names to own. With the names gone from root and stone, the debt has nothing to hold, and its collector will come to the stone in person. Tell the Warmaster what we have called up.
quests.completion: Root and stone have lost their hold on our dead, and Isquarre the Tithe-Eater is coming to collect the claim himself at {name:r20_anchor_077}. Mardra still answers for what she did; no collector gets to turn that judgement into ownership. I will send a group against his body, but whatever gives him his orders beneath the ground remains beyond our reach.

objectives.label: Burn our dead off the tally

quests.title: The Answering Blow
quests.text: I put my ear to the crack after he fell and listened longer than I meant to; it still burns, and he will come back to collect. Carry my account to the Warmaster at Bannerbreak Warhold word for word, so the drill yard hears it too. His last blow struck the ground. The answering blow came from underneath.
quests.completion: Greda Stonehaul at Bannerbreak Mining Camp and The Oathdelvers have my backing for honest wages and promised supplies, and the Warhold keeps the recovered names, Mardra's with her treason recorded, because none of them ever belonged to Isquarre. His last blow struck the ground. The answering blow came from underneath.
